meta.title: Petaloff — fullstack developer
meta.description: Hi, I'm Petaloff. I write Discord bots, Minecraft mods and plugins on Fabric and Paper, and the odd Next.js site. Here are my projects, how they work, and a devlog.

hero.title: I write Discord bots and Minecraft mods
hero.lead: I like bots that quietly run on a thousand servers and mods you want to install twice. That's what I make.

about.title: About
about.body:
I've been into computers and programming **since early childhood**. I tried building little radio circuits and all sorts of things on Arduino and ESP. But all of it was just copying sketches into “my own” project :)

I count **hanging out on Discord** as the real start of my path as a developer: I watched other people build all kinds of cool stuff. Then I tried **Python** myself and wrote my first game, “guess the number”. Next came the school CS exam: I studied the language more deeply, started learning algorithms and wrote my first **Discord bot** for a server. It was a painfully simple ticket bot, but I sank dozens of days into it…

After the exams I realised I wanted to try something else. I tried different languages and tools: C, C++, Java, C#, JS, Go. That went on for about a year. In the end **Java and C#** felt closest to me. I started writing more complex bots, tried building **REST APIs** and slowly learned the principles of OOP.

Then I got really into the idea of running **my own Minecraft server**. There were plenty of failed attempts, some worked out, some even made me money, but right now all of those projects are closed, and one of them, “Petale-Project”, is on hold.

**These days** I write plugins for my future project and sometimes take commissions. In my free time I also build sites like this one.

My favourite part is when **something complicated looks simple from the outside**.
